To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the use of hyperspectral reflectance data collected from a moving vessel in the coastal environment is feasible; 2) the use of two different processing methods (i.e., the empirical line method and a semi-analytical algorithm) to derive reflectance data from the hyperspectral data is possible; 3) the reflectance data derived using the two processing methods are similar; and 4) the reflectance values are similar to those derived from MODIS and VIIRS data.
